standard: 2026 M3 baseline (Material 3 Expressive-ready, dynamic color, edge-to-edge)

color.contrast: M3 default contrast; text on surface only

typography: M3 default type scale (headlineSmall titles, titleMedium cards)

layout.edgeToEdge: enableEdgeToEdge + Scaffold contentPadding on all screens
layout.adaptive: single pane, content widthIn(max=840dp) centered on tablets/foldables
layout.rtl: supportsRtl=true; Rows auto-mirror; no absolute left/right paddings; AutoMirrored back icon

components.fab: M3 FloatingActionButton + Filled Add icon + add_desc
components.inputs: OutlinedTextField singleLine with labels (FR default, AR translation)
components.sliders: M3 Slider with contentDescription = visible label

i18n.rules: no hardcoded user-visible strings; every new string added in FR + AR

a11y: min touch target 48dp (M3 buttons); icon-only buttons always contentDescription; sliders labelled
offline: no INTERNET permission; Camera permission only
